metadata.title: Topping's conjecture for solutions of harmonic map flow with isolated bubbles
metadata.abstract: By establishing a weighted Lojasiewicz-Simon inequality for maps which are close to a fixed harmonic map modulo scaling, we prove Topping's conjecture on continuity of the body map in the case of finite time singularities at which only isolated bubbles form.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 调和映射流奇点连续性
analysis.workSummary: 以加权 Łojasiewicz–Simon 不等式证明孤立气泡有限时奇点下的 body map 连续性。
techniques: 缩放模下的调和映射邻域
analysis.breakthrough: 在孤立气泡情形解决 Topping 猜想。
analysis.limitations: 仍需有限时且只形成孤立气泡的条件。

analysis.priorityReason: 按几何相关性、结果新颖性、技术可复用性及摘要证据清晰度综合评分 81/100；重点在于在孤立气泡情形解决 Topping 猜想。
